[in LXX for חפץ ,אבה; with neg., מאן pi., etc. ;]
to will, be willing, wish, desire (more frequently than βούλομαι, which see, in vernac. and late Gk., also in MGr.; for various views as to its relation to β., see Thayer, 286; but see also BL, §24, see word): absol., Rom.9:16, 1Co.4:19 12:18, Jas.4:15; τ. θεοῦ θέλοντος, Act.18:21; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.20:21, Mrk.14:36, Jhn.15:7, Rom.7:15, 16 1Co.4:21 7:36, Gal.5:17; with inf., Mat.5:40, Mrk.10:43, Jhn.6:21, 67 Rom.7:21, Gal.4:9; with accusative and inf., Mrk.7:24, Luk.1:62, Jhn.21:22, 23 Rom.16:19, 1Co.14:5, Gal.6:13; οὐ θέλω, Mat.18:30, al.; id. with inf., Mat.2:18, Mrk.6:26, Jhn.5:40, 1Co.16:7; before ἵνα, Mat.7:12, Mrk.6:25, Jhn.17:24; opposite to ποιέω, πράσσω, ἐνεργέω, Rom.7:15, 19 2Co.8:10, 11 Php.2:13; before ἤ (ICG, in l.; Deiss., LAE, 179:24), 1Co.14:19; θέλων ἐν ταπεινοφροσυνῄ (of his own mere will, by humility, R, mg), Col.2:18; in OT quotations, for Heb. חפץ, with accusative of person(s), Mat.27:43; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.9:13 12:7, Heb.10:5, 8; with inf., 1Pe.3:10; for אמר, with inf., Act.7:28 (see Cremer, 726ff.).

to will, be willing, wish, desire (more frequently than βούλομαι, which see, in vernac. and late Gk., also in MGr.; for various views as to its relation to β., see Thayer, 286; but see also BL, §24, see word): absol., Rom.9:16, 1Co.4:19 12:18, Jas.4:15; τ. θεοῦ θέλοντος, Act.18:21; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.20:21, Mrk.14:36, Jhn.15:7, Rom.7:15, 16 1Co.4:21 7:36, Gal.5:17; with inf., Mat.5:40, Mrk.10:43, Jhn.6:21, 67 Rom.7:21, Gal.4:9; with accusative and inf., Mrk.7:24, Luk.1:62, Jhn.21:22, 23 Rom.16:19, 1Co.14:5, Gal.6:13; οὐ θέλω, Mat.18:30, al.; id. with inf., Mat.2:18, Mrk.6:26, Jhn.5:40, 1Co.16:7; before ἵνα, Mat.7:12, Mrk.6:25, Jhn.17:24; opposite to ποιέω, πράσσω, ἐνεργέω, Rom.7:15, 19 2Co.8:10, 11 Php.2:13; before ἤ (ICG, in l.; Deiss., LAE, 179:24), 1Co.14:19; θέλων ἐν ταπεινοφροσυνῄ (of his own mere will, by humility, R, mg), Col.2:18; in OT quotations, for Heb. חפץ, with accusative of person(s), Mat.27:43; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.9:13 12:7, Heb.10:5, 8; with inf., 1Pe.3:10; for אמר, with inf., Act.7:28 (see Cremer, 726ff.).
(AS)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to determine (as an active option from subjective impulse; whereas G1014 (βούλομαι) properly denotes rather a passive acquiescence in objective considerations), i.e. choose or prefer (literally or figuratively); by implication, to wish, i.e. be inclined to (sometimes adverbially, gladly); impersonally for the future tense, to be about to; by Hebraism, to delight in
strongs_1890.derivation: apparently strengthened from the alternate form of G138 (αἱρέομαι);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: desire, be disposed (forward), intend, list, love, mean, please, have rather, (be) will (have, -ling, - ling(-ly))

occurrences.kjv: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.

occurrences.bsb: “Beware of the scribes. They like to walk around in long robes, and they love the greetings in the marketplaces, the chief seats in the synagogues, and the places of honor at banquets.
occurrences.kjv: Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;

occurrences.bsb: “Where do You want us to prepare it?” they asked.
occurrences.kjv: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?

occurrences.bsb: When Herod saw Jesus, he was greatly pleased. He had wanted to see Him for a long time, because he had heard about Him and was hoping to see Him perform a miracle.
occurrences.kjv: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.

occurrences.bsb: Wanting to release Jesus, Pilate addressed them again,
occurrences.kjv: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.

occurrences.bsb: The next day Jesus decided to set out for Galilee. Finding Philip, He told him, “Follow Me.”
occurrences.kjv: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.

occurrences.bsb: The wind blows where it wishes. You hear its sound, but you do not know where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.”
occurrences.kjv: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.

occurrences.bsb: When Jesus saw him lying there and realized that he had spent a long time in this condition, He asked him, “Do you want to get well?”
occurrences.kjv: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?

occurrences.bsb: For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, so also the Son gives life to whom He wishes.
occurrences.kjv: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.

occurrences.bsb: John was a lamp that burned and gave light, and you were willing for a season to bask in his light.
occurrences.kjv: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.

occurrences.bsb: yet you refuse to come to Me to have life.
occurrences.kjv: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus took the loaves and the fish, gave thanks, and distributed to those who were seated as much as they wanted.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.

occurrences.bsb: Then they were willing to take Him into the boat, and at once the boat reached the shore where they were heading.
occurrences.kjv: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.

occurrences.bsb: So Jesus asked the Twelve, “Do you want to leave too?”
occurrences.kjv: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?

occurrences.bsb: After this, Jesus traveled throughout Galilee. He did not want to travel in Judea, because the Jews there were trying to kill Him.
occurrences.kjv: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone desires to do His will, he will know whether My teaching is from God or whether I speak on My own.
occurrences.kjv: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.

occurrences.bsb: Some of them wanted to seize Him, but no one laid a hand on Him.
occurrences.kjv: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.

occurrences.bsb: You belong to your father, the devil, and you want to carry out his desires. He was a murderer from the beginning, refusing to uphold the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks his native language, because he is a liar and the father of lies.
occurrences.kjv: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

occurrences.bsb: He replied, “I already told you, and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you also want to become His disciples?”
occurrences.kjv: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?

occurrences.bsb: They came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee, and requested of him, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
occurrences.kjv: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.
occurrences.kjv: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.

occurrences.bsb: Aware that they wanted to question Him, Jesus said to them, “Are you asking one another why I said, ‘In a little while you will not see Me, and then after a little while you will see Me’?
occurrences.kjv: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?

occurrences.bsb: Father, I want those You have given Me to be with Me where I am, that they may see the glory You gave Me because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.
occurrences.kjv: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.

occurrences.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted; but when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and someone else will dress you and lead you where you do not want to go.”
occurrences.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you? You follow Me!”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.

occurrences.bsb: Because of this, the rumor spread among the brothers that this disciple would not die. However, Jesus did not say that he would not die, but only, “If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you?”
occurrences.kjv: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?

occurrences.bsb: Astounded and perplexed, they asked one another, “What does this mean?”
occurrences.kjv: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?

occurrences.bsb: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
occurrences.kjv: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?

occurrences.bsb: But our fathers refused to obey him. Instead, they rejected him and in their hearts turned back to Egypt.
occurrences.kjv: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,

occurrences.bsb: He became hungry and wanted something to eat, but while the meal was being prepared, he fell into a trance.
occurrences.kjv: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,

occurrences.bsb: The priest of Zeus, whose temple was just outside the city, brought bulls and wreaths to the city gates, hoping to offer a sacrifice along with the crowds.
occurrences.kjv: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.

occurrences.bsb: Paul wanted Timothy to accompany him, so he took him and circumcised him on account of the Jews in that area, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.
occurrences.kjv: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.

occurrences.bsb: Some Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also began to debate with him. Some of them asked, “What is this babbler trying to say?” Others said, “He seems to be advocating foreign gods.” They said this because Paul was proclaiming the good news of Jesus and the resurrection.
occurrences.kjv: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Jesus, and the resurrection.

occurrences.bsb: For you are bringing some strange notions to our ears, and we want to know what they mean.”
occurrences.kjv: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.

occurrences.bsb: But as he left, he said, “I will come back to you if God is willing.” And he set sail from Ephesus.
occurrences.kjv: But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if God will. And he sailed from Ephesus.

occurrences.bsb: The Jews in the crowd pushed Alexander forward to explain himself, and he motioned for silence so he could make his defense to the people.
occurrences.kjv: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander beckoned with the hand, and would have made his defence unto the people.

occurrences.bsb: After two years had passed, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus. And wishing to do the Jews a favor, Felix left Paul in prison.
occurrences.kjv: But after two years Porcius Festus came into Felix’ room: and Felix, willing to shew the Jews a pleasure, left Paul bound.

occurrences.bsb: But Festus, wishing to do the Jews a favor, said to Paul, “Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem to stand trial before me on these charges?”
occurrences.kjv: But Festus, willing to do the Jews a pleasure, answered Paul, and said, Wilt thou go up to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these things before me?

occurrences.bsb: They have known me for a long time and can testify, if they are willing, that I lived as a Pharisee, adhering to the strictest sect of our religion.
occurrences.kjv: Which knew me from the beginning, if they would testify, that after the most straitest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.

occurrences.bsb: I do not want you to be unaware, brothers, how often I planned to come to you (but have been prevented from visiting until now), in order that I might have a harvest among you, just as I have had among the other Gentiles.
occurrences.kjv: Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.

occurrences.bsb: I do not understand what I do. For what I want to do, I do not do. But what I hate, I do.
occurrences.kjv: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.

occurrences.bsb: And if I do what I do not want to do, I admit that the law is good.
occurrences.kjv: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.

occurrences.bsb: I know that nothing good lives in me, that is, in my flesh; for I have the desire to do what is good, but I cannot carry it out.
occurrences.kjv: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.

occurrences.bsb: For I do not do the good I want to do. Instead, I keep on doing the evil I do not want to do.
occurrences.kjv: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.

occurrences.bsb: And if I do what I do not want, it is no longer I who do it, but it is sin living in me that does it.
occurrences.kjv: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.

occurrences.bsb: So this is the principle I have discovered: When I want to do good, evil is right there with me.
occurrences.kjv: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.

occurrences.bsb: So then, it does not depend on man’s desire or effort, but on God’s mercy.
occurrences.kjv: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore God has mercy on whom He wants to have mercy, and He hardens whom He wants to harden.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.

occurrences.bsb: What if God, intending to show His wrath and make His power known, bore with great patience the vessels of His wrath, prepared for destruction?
occurrences.kjv: What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:

occurrences.bsb: I do not want you to be ignorant of this mystery, brothers, so that you will not be conceited: A hardening in part has come to Israel, until the full number of the Gentiles has come in.
occurrences.kjv: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.

occurrences.bsb: For rulers are not a terror to good conduct, but to bad. Do you want to be unafraid of the one in authority? Then do what is right, and you will have his approval.
occurrences.kjv: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:

occurrences.bsb: Everyone has heard about your obedience, so I rejoice over you. But I want you to be wise about what is good and innocent about what is evil.
occurrences.kjv: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.

occurrences.bsb: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing, and then I will find out not only what these arrogant people are saying, but what power they have.
occurrences.kjv: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord will, and will know, not the speech of them which are puffed up, but the power.

occurrences.bsb: Which do you prefer? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and with a gentle spirit?
occurrences.kjv: What will ye? shall I come unto you with a rod, or in love, and in the spirit of meekness?

occurrences.bsb: I wish that all men were as I am. But each man has his own gift from God; one has this gift, another has that.
occurrences.kjv: For I would that all men were even as I myself. But every man hath his proper gift of God, one after this manner, and another after that.

occurrences.bsb: I want you to be free from concern. The unmarried man is concerned about the work of the Lord, how he can please the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: But I would have you without carefulness. He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to the Lord, how he may please the Lord:

occurrences.bsb: However, if someone thinks he is acting inappropriately toward his betrothed, and if she is beyond her youth and they ought to marry, let him do as he wishes; he is not sinning; they should get married.
occurrences.kjv: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin, if she pass the flower of her age, and need so require, let him do what he will, he sinneth not: let them marry.

occurrences.bsb: A wife is bound to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is free to marry anyone she wishes, as long as he belongs to the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: I do not want you to be unaware, brothers, that our forefathers were all under the cloud, and that they all passed through the sea.
occurrences.kjv: Moreover, brethren, I would not that ye should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

occurrences.bsb: No, but the sacrifices of pagans are offered to demons, not to God. And I do not want you to be participants with demons.
occurrences.kjv: But I say, that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils.

occurrences.bsb: If an unbeliever invites you to a meal and you want to go, eat anything set before you without raising questions of conscience.
occurrences.kjv: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast, and ye be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.

occurrences.bsb: But I want you to understand that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.
occurrences.kjv: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.

occurrences.bsb: Now about spiritual gifts, brothers, I do not want you to be uninformed.
occurrences.kjv: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.

occurrences.bsb: But in fact, God has arranged the members of the body, every one of them, according to His design.
occurrences.kjv: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.

occurrences.bsb: I wish that all of you could speak in tongues, but I would rather have you prophesy. He who prophesies is greater than one who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets so that the church may be edified.
occurrences.kjv: I would that ye all spake with tongues, but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.

occurrences.bsb: But in the church, I would rather speak five coherent words to instruct others than ten thousand words in a tongue.
occurrences.kjv: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.

occurrences.bsb: If they wish to inquire about something, they are to ask their own husbands at home; for it is dishonorable for a woman to speak in the church.
occurrences.kjv: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.

occurrences.bsb: But God gives it a body as He has designed, and to each kind of seed He gives its own body.
occurrences.kjv: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.

occurrences.bsb: For I do not want to see you now only in passing; I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord permits.
occurrences.kjv: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.

occurrences.bsb: We do not want you to be unaware, brothers, of the hardships we encountered in the province of Asia. We were under a burden far beyond our ability to endure, so that we despaired even of life.
occurrences.kjv: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:

occurrences.bsb: For while we are in this tent, we groan under our burdens, because we do not wish to be unclothed but clothed, so that our mortality may be swallowed up by life.
occurrences.kjv: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.

occurrences.bsb: And this is my opinion about what is helpful for you in this matter: Last year you were the first not only to give, but even to have such a desire.
occurrences.kjv: And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.

occurrences.bsb: Now finish the work, so that you may complete it with the same eager desire, according to your means.
occurrences.kjv: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.

occurrences.bsb: But I will keep on doing what I am doing, in order to undercut those who want an opportunity to be regarded as our equals in the things of which they boast.
occurrences.kjv: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.

occurrences.bsb: Even if I wanted to boast, I would not be a fool, because I would be speaking the truth. But I refrain, so no one will credit me with more than he sees in me or hears from me,
occurrences.kjv: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be, or that he heareth of me.

occurrences.bsb: For I am afraid that when I come, I may not find you as I wish, and you may not find me as you wish. I fear that there may be quarreling, jealousy, rage, rivalry, slander, gossip, arrogance, and disorder.
occurrences.kjv: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:

occurrences.bsb: which is not even a gospel. Evidently some people are troubling you and trying to distort the gospel of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: I would like to learn just one thing from you: Did you receive the Spirit by works of the law, or by hearing with faith?
occurrences.kjv: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

occurrences.bsb: But now that you know God, or rather are known by God, how is it that you are turning back to those weak and worthless principles? Do you wish to be enslaved by them all over again?
occurrences.kjv: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?

occurrences.bsb: Those people are zealous for you, but not in a good way. Instead, they want to isolate you from us, so that you may be zealous for them.
occurrences.kjv: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.

occurrences.bsb: how I wish I could be with you now and change my tone, because I am perplexed about you.
occurrences.kjv: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.

occurrences.bsb: Tell me, you who want to be under the law, do you not understand what the law says?
occurrences.kjv: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?

occurrences.bsb: For the flesh craves what is contrary to the Spirit, and the Spirit what is contrary to the flesh. They are opposed to each other, so that you do not do what you want.
occurrences.kjv: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.

occurrences.bsb: Those who want to make a good impression outwardly are trying to compel you to be circumcised. They only do this to avoid persecution for the cross of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: For the circumcised do not even keep the law themselves, yet they want you to be circumcised that they may boast in your flesh.
occurrences.kjv: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.

occurrences.bsb: For it is God who works in you to will and to act on behalf of His good purpose.
occurrences.kjv: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.

occurrences.bsb: To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
occurrences.kjv: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

occurrences.bsb: For I want you to know how much I am struggling for you and for those at Laodicea, and for all who have not met me face to face,
occurrences.kjv: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

occurrences.bsb: Do not let anyone who delights in false humility and the worship of angels disqualify you with speculation about what he has seen. Such a person is puffed up without basis by his unspiritual mind.
occurrences.kjv: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

occurrences.bsb: For we wanted to come to you—indeed I, Paul, tried again and again—but Satan obstructed us.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.

occurrences.bsb: Brothers, we do not want you to be uninformed about those who sleep in death, so that you will not grieve like the rest, who are without hope.
occurrences.kjv: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.

occurrences.bsb: For even while we were with you, we gave you this command: “If anyone is unwilling to work, he shall not eat.”
occurrences.kjv: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.

occurrences.bsb: They want to be teachers of the law, but they do not understand what they are saying or that which they so confidently assert.
occurrences.kjv: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.

occurrences.bsb: who wants everyone to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.
occurrences.kjv: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.

occurrences.bsb: But refuse to enroll younger widows. For when their passions draw them away from Christ, they will want to marry,
occurrences.kjv: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;

occurrences.bsb: Indeed, all who desire to live godly lives in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,
occurrences.kjv: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

occurrences.bsb: But I did not want to do anything without your consent, so that your goodness will not be out of compulsion, but by your own free will.
occurrences.kjv: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, when Christ came into the world, He said: “Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but a body You prepared for Me.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:

occurrences.bsb: In the passage above He says, “Sacrifices and offerings, burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not desire, nor did You delight in them” (although they are offered according to the law).
occurrences.kjv: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure therein; which are offered by the law;

occurrences.bsb: For you know that afterward, when he wanted to inherit the blessing, he was rejected. He could find no ground for repentance, though he sought the blessing with tears.
occurrences.kjv: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.

occurrences.bsb: Pray for us; we are convinced that we have a clear conscience and desire to live honorably in every way.
occurrences.kjv: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.

occurrences.bsb: O foolish man, do you want evidence that faith without deeds is worthless?
occurrences.kjv: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?

occurrences.bsb: Instead, you ought to say, “If the Lord is willing, we will live and do this or that.”
occurrences.kjv: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.

occurrences.bsb: For, “Whoever would love life and see good days must keep his tongue from evil and his lips from deceitful speech.
occurrences.kjv: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:

occurrences.bsb: For it is better, if it is God’s will, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.
occurrences.kjv: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.

occurrences.bsb: But they deliberately overlook the fact that long ago by God’s word the heavens existed and the earth was formed out of water and by water,
occurrences.kjv: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:

occurrences.bsb: I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with pen and ink.
occurrences.kjv: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:

occurrences.bsb: Even though I have given her time to repent of her immorality, she is unwilling.
occurrences.kjv: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone wants to harm them, fire proceeds from their mouths and devours their enemies. In this way, anyone who wants to harm them must be killed.
occurrences.kjv: And if any man will hurt them, fire proceedeth out of their mouth, and devoureth their enemies: and if any man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed.

occurrences.bsb: These witnesses have power to shut the sky so that no rain will fall during the days of their prophecy, and power to turn the waters into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they wish.
occurrences.kjv: These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.

occurrences.bsb: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Let the one who hears say, “Come!” And let the one who is thirsty come, and the one who desires the water of life drink freely.
occurrences.kjv: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
